_description: E-069b — the cone-native codec (the encoder that reads a 30-day dependency cone of past dots around a pixel instead of one snapshot of it) under the frozen protocol (train on everything up to 2020, test on 2021-2024, with 2008-2009 and 2016-2017 also held out), with ONE thing changed from f4r3-cone-7M-terminal.json: the masking plan, so that the loss asks the question the hypothesis poses. Three changes, and each removes a way the old loss could be satisfied without learning anything. First, a hidden channel is now hidden only at the present-day patch: its past dots stay visible, so the model has to read the channel's own history to say what it is doing now. Second, hidden dots come only from the two schemes that hide part of a channel the model can still see — a band of the most recent lags (which asks it to step time forward) and a 90-degree wedge of bearings (which asks it to interpolate across directions) — so no dot target belongs to a channel that is absent from the input. Third, the anchor family, the part of the loss that asks for the pixel's own present-day values, now scores only the hidden channels; before, most of its weight sat on channels whose answer was sitting in the input as the middle cell of the 3x3 patch, which is copying rather than reconstruction. The net effect: no target is a copy of something visible, and no target is unknowable from what is visible. Everything else — geometry (Perceiver, 64 latents x width 256 x 6 blocks, 8 heads, decoder 256 x 2, code width 32, batch 256), inner window of 6 pentads = 30 days, 256 dot queries per anchor, future lags 1 and 2, learning rate, held-out years — is identical to f4r3-cone-7M-terminal.json, so the comparison between the two runs is a comparison of the masking plan and nothing else. cone_snapshot_ablation stays true: the hypothesis is read as the cone codec's velocity R-squared against its own snapshot twin (the same model with the cone switched off, seeing only the present-day patch), and a run without the twin cannot answer it at all.
_provenance: Designed 2026-09-03 after #539 (seed 1 of E-069 under the frozen protocol) measured hidden-dot MSE 1.001 on 64% of the loss weight and a cone velocity R² of 0.10 against a snapshot twin at 0.69 that equals the raw-patch bar (0.665/0.701).
